bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $160 转折点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 3.2% on Oct 13 to $157.06 and is down 14% in five sessions; with 67 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its 5-day ($167.4), 10-day ($178.7) and 30-day ($181.1) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($194.8), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月13日下跌 3.2%，收于 $157.06，五个交易日下跌 14%；上市仅 67 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于 5 日（$167.4）、10 日（$178.7）和 30 日均线（$181.1）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$194.8），RSI 为 36。

read.en: It closed below the $160 July pivot, which turns into first resistance; the day's low of $151.92 tested the $151.5 Aug 24 pivot. Below that are $145.6 (Jul 17 pivot) and the $124.80 July low, the floor of its short history. Above $160, resistance is $167.4 (5-day average), then $179–181 (10 and 30-day averages). Switch to the Seoul listing above for the longer trend.
read.zh: 股价收于 $160 的 7月转折点下方，该位置转为第一阻力；当日低点 $151.92 测试了 $151.5 的 8月24日转折点。其下为 $145.6（7月17日转折点）及 $124.80 的 7月低点，即其短暂历史的底部。$160 之上，阻力为 $167.4（5 日均线），其次 $179–181（10 日和 30 日均线）。如需观察更长周期趋势，可切换至上方的首尔上市股票。

s.en: July low, floor of its history

bias.zh: 偏空 · 测试 200 日均线

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,443,000 in Seoul on Oct 13, 52% below the June record, after an intraday low of ₩1,425,000. It slipped just under its 200-day average (₩1,449,675) and is below its falling 5, 10 and 30-day averages (₩1.58–1.73 million) and the 100-day (₩1.93 million). MACD is below its signal and zero line, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28, and RSI is 31.
read.zh: SK 海力士 10月13日在首尔收于 ₩1,443,000，较 6月纪录高点低 52%，盘中低点 ₩1,425,000。股价略跌破 200 日均线（₩1,449,675），并位于下行的 5 日、10 日和 30 日均线（₩158万–173万）及 100 日均线（₩193万）下方。MACD 位于信号线及零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空，RSI 为 31。

read.en: The Sep 2 low (₩1,558,000) gave way and is now first resistance, with the 5-day average (₩1,579,000) just above it and the Sep 14 low (₩1,671,000) beyond. The 200-day zone near ₩1,441,000–1,450,000 is being tested; below it, support is the Aug 10 low of ₩1,373,000, then the Jul 28 low of ₩1,246,000. A close below ₩1,425,000 would open ₩1,373,000.
